title: Newmark Advises on Launch of Perennial Housing Group, Seeded by Recapitalization of 31 Affordable Housing Properties

body_markdown:
**November 18, 2026 9:00 AM**
Newmark announces the Company has advised on the strategic recapitalization of Infinity Real Estate’s Affordable Housing, and the launch of Perennial Housing Group (“Perennial”). Perennial is seeded by 31 project-based rental assistance properties across the Southeast and Midwest.


Newmark’s advisory team was led by Co-Heads of[Affordable Housing Advisors](https://www.nmrk.com/services/property-types/multifamily-capital-markets/affordable-housing)[Matt Kurzmann](https://www.nmrk.com/people/matt-kurzmann) and[Andrew Daitch](https://www.nmrk.com/people/andrew-daitch) , alongside[Andrew Warin](https://www.nmrk.com/people/andrew-warin) and[Chris Hope](https://www.nmrk.com/people/chris-hope) of the firm’s Strategic Advisory & Liquidity Solutions group.


A group of institutional investors acquired a controlling interest in Perennial’s management company and is supporting the growth of the business to $1 billion or more of asset value over time. The investment is expected to meaningfully expand Perennial’s portfolio and support continued growth in the Affordable Housing sector. Perennial intends to grow through the acquisition of additional project-based rental assistance properties in its core Southeast and Midwest markets and beyond, with a focus on preserving long-term affordability for residents and delivering consistent, high-quality operations.


Infinity’s senior leadership team will continue as Perennial’s management team, which preserves continuity of management in a niche sector that demands specialized operating expertise.


**About Newmark**
Newmark Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: NMRK), together with its subsidiaries (“Newmark”), is a world leading commercial real estate advisor and service provider to large institutional investors and other owners, global corporations and other occupiers, and lenders. Built with purpose and driven by excellence, Newmark’s comprehensive platform is uniquely tailored to provide superior outcomes to clients. For the twelve months ended September 30, 2026, Newmark generated revenues of over $3.7 billion. As of September 30, 2026, Newmark and its business partners together operated from approximately 200 offices with 10,500 professionals across four continents.
